title: Website eCommerce Full Flow (Cart→Checkout→Payment→sale.order→Delivery)
phase: Second-Pass Depth Closure — P2 Supporting Domains

key_findings.cart_model: The eCommerce cart IS a sale.order (not a separate model). website_sale extends sale.order with website_id (Many2one to website). A cart is a sale.order in state=draft with website_id set.
key_findings.cart_creation: website._create_cart() creates the sale.order with SUPERUSER_ID and stores the id in request.session['sale_order_id'] (CART_SESSION_CACHE_KEY). _prepare_sale_order_values() populates company_id, partner_id, fiscal_position_id, pricelist_id, team_id, website_id.
key_findings.cart_session_link: Cart is linked to session via CART_SESSION_CACHE_KEY='sale_order_id'. _get_and_cache_current_cart() retrieves, validates (state=draft, no processed tx, same website), and caches. Logged-in users also get abandoned cart resurrection (search by partner_id+website_id+state=draft).
key_findings.visitor_cart_link: website.visitor model tracks page/product views but does NOT directly link to cart. Cart-to-visitor association is session-based only.
key_findings.checkout_flow: 3 steps: (1) /shop/checkout — address + delivery selection; (2) /shop/address — address form; (3) /shop/payment — payment provider selection. Checkout controller: shop_checkout() at GET /shop/checkout. Delivery methods fetched via _get_delivery_methods() (website_published=True + company domain + carrier availability filter), applied via _set_delivery_method().
key_findings.guest_checkout: Controlled by website.account_on_checkout (Selection: optional/disabled/mandatory). If mandatory AND user is public → redirect to /web/login. Otherwise public users (guests) can checkout freely. Guest cart: partner_id == website public user partner.
key_findings.payment_transaction_states: 6 states: draft → pending → authorized → done (Confirmed) → [cancel/error]. _set_done() allows from draft/pending/authorized/error. _set_canceled() only from draft/pending/authorized. Each transition resets is_post_processed=False.
key_findings.payment_to_SO_confirm_chain: _post_process() (sale module override): for state=done → _check_amount_and_confirm_order() → if exactly one linked SO, state in draft/sent, not requiring signature, _is_confirmation_amount_reached() → quotation.action_confirm(send_email=True). action_confirm() writes state='sale', date_order=now() via _prepare_confirmation_values(), then calls _action_confirm().
key_findings.delivery_trigger: sale_stock._action_confirm() calls order_line._action_launch_stock_rule() which creates procurements and calls stock.rule.run(procurements). This creates stock.picking and stock.move records. Newly created pickings are immediately confirmed via picking.action_confirm() to trigger scheduler.
key_findings.email_confirmation: _send_order_confirmation_mail() is called from action_confirm() when context send_email=True. Template resolution: website.confirmation_email_template_id if set, else sale module default template.
key_findings.product_publishing: product.template inherits website.published.multi.mixin. is_published (stored Boolean) is the real flag. website_published (computed) = is_published AND (no website_id OR website_id matches context). Unscoped products appear on all websites when published.
key_findings.pricelist_mechanism: Pricelist stored in session under PRICELIST_SESSION_CACHE_KEY. Cart created with pricelist_id from request.pricelist. _compute_pricelist_id() override applies GeoIP country_code for eCommerce carts. Visitor can explicitly select a pricelist (PRICELIST_SELECTED_SESSION_CACHE_KEY).
key_findings.bundled_payment_providers: Community 19 bundles: payment_custom, payment_demo, payment_paypal, payment_stripe, payment_adyen, payment_mollie, payment_razorpay, payment_authorize, payment_buckaroo, payment_dpo, payment_ecpay, payment_flutterwave, payment_iyzico, payment_mercado_pago, payment_nuvei, payment_paymob, payment_payu, payment_redsys, payment_toss_payments, payment_worldline, payment_xendit, payment_aps, payment_asiapay.
key_findings.automatic_invoice: Controlled by ir.config_parameter 'sale.automatic_invoice'. When True: done tx triggers _invoice_sale_orders(). Fully paid → final invoice via _create_invoices(); partially paid → downpayment invoice via _generate_downpayment_invoices().
key_findings.zero_amount_order: No tx created for zero-amount orders. /shop/payment/validate calls _check_cart_is_ready_to_be_paid() then _validate_order() which calls action_confirm(send_email=True) directly.
key_findings.cron_post_processing: _cron_post_process() retries is_post_processed=False transactions within last 4 days, handling cases where the client redirect did not complete.
